name: Will widening my laundry room doorway affect my home's value?

mainEntity.name: Will widening my laundry room doorway affect my home's value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Widening a laundry room doorway can positively affect your home's value, especially if it improves functionality and accessibility. Modern buyers appreciate features that accommodate contemporary appliances and enhance ease of movement throughout the home. This upgrade can be particularly appealing if it addresses a common pain point in older homes with narrow doorways, making the laundry room more practical and the home more marketable.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, widening a laundry room doorway can increase home value by improving functionality and accessibility for modern appliances.
